translate_en|mods/TDDUPMedicalFramework/: Reduces fluid-loss/cramping states in the diagnostic medical stomach-illness model.
Reduces nausea and vomiting-risk states in the diagnostic medical stomach-illness model.
Reduces simulated allergy flare symptoms in the medical model.
Comfort supply for simulated blisters and foot pain.
Simple broth comfort supply for nausea, dehydration, and recovery roleplay.
Comfort treatment for simulated minor burns and sunburn.
Clean field-care supplies for safer wound treatment.
Reduces simulated cough and respiratory discomfort. Does not cure infections.
Reduces simulated congestion from cold, allergy, smoke, or dust exposure.
Supports simulated sprains, swelling, and mobility pain.
Diagnostic medical supply for dehydration recovery. Restores fluids/electrolyte balance in the health model.
Reduces simulated watery-eye and smoke/dust eye irritation.
Helps simulated wet-feet irritation and blister recovery.
Two gauze packs plus tape. Better than nothing for small wounds, but weaker than a proper bandage.
Four gauze packs plus tape. A basic field bandage; useful, but not as reliable as a pressure dressing.
Clean gauze pack used with medical tape to craft field dressings.
Short-term comfort treatment for simulated chills, cramps, and soreness.
Six gauze packs plus tape. Emergency heavy bleeding dressing; good enough to buy time, still inferior to trauma supplies.
Emergency bleed-control gauze for serious bleeding. Does not count as a bandage; follow with a pressure dressing or clean wound care.
Short-term comfort treatment for simulated sprains, swelling, heat strain, or minor burns.
A box of clean medical gloves. Surgical gloves reduce dirty-hand treatment risk when worn.
A box of disposable medical masks. Surgical masks reduce close-proximity cold spread.
Secures dressings and improves field treatment quality.
Better protection from pollen, dust, and respiratory exposure than a basic mask.
Sterile saline rinse for dirty wounds. Cleans less aggressively than alcohol or disinfectant but is gentler and safer for field care.
Prepared rehydration drink for dehydration or stomach illness recovery.
Emergency dressing that applies strong pressure to traumatic bleeding. Buys time but still needs follow-up care.
Broad field-care kit for simulated short-term recovery states.
Supports an injured arm during short-term recovery. The medical model can mark the arm as temporarily limited.
Compact field kit for dehydration and stomach-illness care.
Limb-only emergency bleeding control. Powerful, painful, and time-limited.
Rare emergency kit for stabilizing serious bleeding.
Cuts clothing away quickly for field treatment. Improves treatment preparedness.
